name: Restylane Volyme

card.summary: Restylane Volyme is a Galderma hyaluronic acid filler, built on OBT technology, used by clinicians to restore volume in areas such as the cheeks.
card.note: Injectable medical procedure; results are temporary and reversible with hyaluronidase.

quick.overview:
Restylane Volyme is a hyaluronic acid (HA) gel filler from Galderma, part of the Restylane family. It is used by trained injectors to add volume under the skin.
For appearance, cheek and midface volume lifts the face, adds projection and softens hollows. Fillers are popular in hardmaxxing discussions as a non-surgical way to change facial contours.
quick.how: A clinician injects the gel with a fine needle or cannula, often after numbing cream or anesthetic. Results are visible quickly and then gradually fade over time, so some people repeat treatments. Specific products and techniques are chosen by the injector.
quick.risks: Common effects of Restylane-family fillers are temporary bruising, swelling and numbness. Lumps or granulomas are rare, and HA filler can be dissolved with hyaluronidase. It is not established as safe in pregnancy or breastfeeding, and people with severe allergies, HA allergy, active infection at the site, or bleeding problems need clinician guidance.

lead: Restylane is the trade name for a range of injectable fillers made from hyaluronic acid and produced by Galderma. Wikipedia describes it as the first HA filler approved by the US FDA for cosmetic injection beneath facial skin [1].

Restylane Volyme, sometimes written Volyme OBT after the manufacturer's gel technology, belongs to this family and is positioned for volume restoration such as the cheeks. Wikipedia's Restylane article does not cover Volyme specifically, and Galderma's US Restylane page did not list it in the products shown, so product-level detail should come from the manufacturer or a clinician.
Restylane fillers in general are used for lips, nasolabial folds, marionette lines, under-eye hollows and volume in the cheeks, chin and nose [1].

chain: HA gel placed in the midface
Lifted, fuller cheek contour that lasts for a while
angle.text: Filler restores or adds volume where an injector places it, changing the shape of the cheeks and midface without surgery. The change fades over time.

paras: Restylane products are most commonly used for lip enhancement, and also for folds, under-eye hollows and volume in cheeks, chin and nose [1].

Temporary bruising, swelling and numbness are common, and rare lumps or granulomas can be reversed with hyaluronidase [1]. Contraindications include severe allergy or anaphylaxis, HA allergy and active infection or inflammation at the site; people with bleeding disorders or on blood thinners need close monitoring [1].
No studies have examined Restylane Volyme specifically.
Fillers are discussed in the hardmaxxing category as a non-surgical route to cheek and midface changes. No community threads about this product were available.
